sections.title: One more person to add
sections.content: You already mark "my X" and "your X" with a suffix from A1. "His/her X" works the same way, adding -a/-e or -ja/-je depending on the noun — which one is mostly predictable from the noun's ending, the way -tól/-től was.

items.english: This is Károly's father and mother.

sections.content: Notice the pattern isn't tied to one person — Ez Anna apja is also "this is Anna's father": name + noun + -a/-e/-ja/-je says whose it is without needing a separate word for "of".
